summary: Sharp risk-off evening: BTC fell ~5-6% from above $80k to a $75.6k range low with ~$400M of longs liquidated in an hour, tracking a Nasdaq drop of over 3% on AI-spend worries after the midterms. Range $75k-$81k still intact. White House began reviewing an SEC proposal easing crypto broker-dealer rules (mild positive). US jobs report Fri 13:30 UK is the next swing factor.
catalyst_note: 2026-11-05 White House review of SEC crypto broker-dealer rule proposal (RIN 3235-AN48); Nov 6 US payrolls due
